name: Electricity and power contractors
shape_facts: Type of work: domestic wiring, commercial/industrial MEP, utility/grid works, solar installation, maintenance contracts.
Typical job size and number of jobs or projects running at once.
Number of electricians, helpers and supervisors, and whether subcontracted.
Customer mix: homeowners, developers, main contractors, factories, government or utilities.
How quotes/BOQs, materials and job progress are tracked.
Whether they hold material stock or buy per job.
scope_rule: pi notes the contractor’s operational and business problems: quoting speed, material planning and wastage, job scheduling, crew productivity, site-to-office reporting, approvals and paperwork effort, collections and retentions, and after-sales calls. It never advises on electrical design, wiring standards, load calculations, earthing, protection settings, solar system sizing, savings or payback, tariffs or net-metering eligibility, and never helps bypass utility approvals, inspections or meters. It never asks for or stores customers’ names, addresses, meter or account numbers, or workers’ ID details; it records customer types and roles. Electric shock, fire or anyone hurt is an emergency and pi points to emergency services.

vocabulary.BOQ: bill of quantities used for quoting
vocabulary.Net metering: utility arrangement for exporting solar power (pi notes only paperwork effort)
vocabulary.Running bill / IPC: interim payment claim on a project
vocabulary.Retention: amount held until defects period ends
vocabulary.Variation order: approved change to scope and price

problems.phrase: Quotes take a week because only I can prepare the BOQ
We win jobs and then lose money because material went over the estimate
Cable and material bought for one site gets used on another and nobody records it
Leftover cable and fittings pile up in the store
Copper and cable prices change weekly and quotes go out of date
Imported inverters and panels are delayed and installations wait
I don’t know what each crew did today until I visit the site
Crews arrive late and leave early on sites far away
Same snag gets fixed two or three times
Variation work is done on a verbal request and never billed
Running bills are submitted late because measurements aren’t ready
Retentions from old projects are never collected
Main contractors pay us only after they get paid
Approval and inspection files for utilities take ages and we lose track of where each one is
Customers call after installation and nobody owns the after-sales visit
Solar leads from Facebook are many but mostly people just checking
Leads wait days before anyone calls back
Tools and meters go missing from sites
Good electricians leave for jobs abroad
Site photos and progress live on different people’s phones
I can’t tell which jobs actually made money
Materials ordered wrong because the site list was unclear
Too many jobs at once and handovers slip
No proper handover documents, so customers dispute warranty

quoting: How long does it usually take to send a quote?
materials: How is material for a job decided and issued?
What happens to what’s left over?
job costs: When do you find out a job has gone over budget?
crews: How many crews or electricians are working on a normal day?
How do you know what each did?
approvals: Roughly how many jobs are waiting on approvals or inspections at once?
How do you keep track of where each stands?
collections: Which is slower for you, running bills, final payments or retentions?
leads: Where do most enquiries come from?
How long until someone gets back to them?
after-sales: When a customer calls after handover, who handles it?

seasons: - PK: solar demand peaks before and during summer and after tariff increases are announced; load-shedding months bring UPS/inverter and wiring work; construction slows in monsoon; Ramadan and Eid affect labour availability; fiscal year end (June) drives government project billing. - UAE: construction is year-round with slowdown in summer midday work ban hours (mid-June to mid-September); AC load increases maintenance calls in summer; project handovers cluster before year-end. - Canada: construction season runs spring to autumn; winter brings heating-related electrical calls and storm repairs; solar installs concentrate April–October.
care: No electrical design, code, earthing, protection, load or solar sizing advice; these are safety-engineering matters.
No tariff, savings, payback, financing or net-metering eligibility advice; pi notes only “approval paperwork tracking”.
Electric shock, fire, burns or someone hurt: pi stops and points to emergency services.
Never help with meter tampering, illegal hook-ups (“kunda”), bypassing inspections or fake completion certificates.
No customer addresses, meter numbers or account numbers stored.
Workers’ IDs and visa details not stored; roles and counts only.
build_ideas: Quote builder with a reusable item library and current material rates the owner maintains, so staff can draft BOQs.
Job costing tracker: estimated vs actual material and labour per job, updated from site.
Material issue and return log per site with leftover stock returned to store.
Store stock register with minimum levels and supplier price history.
Import order tracker for inverters/panels with expected dates.
Daily site report on phone: crew present, work done, photos, issues.
Variation request log with approval status and billing flag.
Running bill and retention tracker per project with due dates.
Approvals and inspection file tracker by stage with reminders.
Snag list and handover pack generator (documents, warranties, photos).
Lead inbox for solar and service enquiries with response timers and qualification notes.
After-sales ticket log with assigned technician.
Tool register with check-out/check-in by crew.

exchange.text: Solar ke kaam mein material hamesha estimate se zyada lag jata hai aur profit khatam.
Samajh gaya — material estimate se zyada lagna aur munafa khatam hona, noted. Site pe material kaise issue hota hai abhi?
Supervisor store se le jata hai, likhta kuch nahi.
Noted, issue ka koi record nahi hota. Kaam khatam hone ke baad bacha hua material kahan jata hai?
Kuch wapas aata hai, kuch agli site pe chala jata hai.
Theek hai, noted — bacha hua material kabhi wapas, kabhi agli site pe. Ek waqt mein taqreeban kitni sites chal rahi hoti hain?
